name: influxdb2
title: InfluxDB2
description: Interact with InfluxDB v2, a time series database.
label: database

properties.name: connectionBean
properties.description: Connection to the Influx database, of class com.influxdb.client.InfluxDBClient.class.

properties.name: autoCreateBucket
properties.description: Define if we want to auto create the bucket if it's not present.

properties.name: autoCreateOrg
properties.description: Define if we want to auto create the organization if it's not present.

properties.name: bucket
properties.description: The name of the bucket where the time series will be stored.

properties.name: operation
properties.description: Define if this operation is an insert of ping.

properties.name: org
properties.description: The name of the organization where the time series will be stored.

properties.name: retentionPolicy
properties.description: Define the retention policy to the data created by the endpoint.

properties.name: writePrecision
properties.description: The format or precision of time series timestamps.

properties.name: lazyStartProducer
properties.label: producer,advanced
properties.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.
